references.text: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, cries out to Jesus with the title 'Son of David,' a messianic title that shows his faith in Jesus as the Messiah.
The prophecy in Isaiah that the Messiah will open the eyes of the blind, which Bartimaeus believes Jesus can do for him.
Two blind men cry out to Jesus as 'Son of David,' a title also used by Bartimaeus, showing recognition of Jesus as the Messiah.
Two blind men by the road cry out to Jesus, calling him 'Son of David,' a parallel to Bartimaeus' cry.
A blind man cries out to Jesus, calling him 'Son of David,' reflecting a shared faith in Jesus as the Messiah.
